schema.unattributedOutsideActions: marks observed outside every action span with class totals above 1 ms; the remainder is pooled in unattributedOmittedMs. Never attributed to an action.
schema.nestingPairs: parent > child label pairs observed inside the measured accepted actions.
schema.comparability: This S7 file is keyed; the S1 profile file is positional against its own markNames list. The comparable values are the per-label distributions.
